title: Crop Input Purchasing Accounts: Discount and Rebate Rate Card
content:
The rates below are the discount and rebate rates each programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries, together with the basis on which several discounts landing on one invoice combine and the acres a programme rebate is earned above.

| Programme | Early pay rate (percent) | Early pay window (calendar days) | Volume threshold (USD) | Volume rate (percent) | Prepay rate (percent) | Stacking basis | Programme rebate (percent) | Rebate acres |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | no discounts offered | 0 | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 1 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | best single discount | 0 | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 1.5 | 15 | 75000 | 1 | 0 | best single discount | 0 | 0 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 | prepay then volume, added together | 0 | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 2 | 15 | 150000 | 1.5 | 4 | prepay then volume, added together | 1 | 500 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 2.5 | 20 | 250000 | 2 | 4.5 | prepay then volume, added together | 1.5 | 1000 |

## Notes to the card

1. A rate shown as 0 is a rate the programme does not carry.

2. The early pay window is counted in whole calendar days from the invoice date, and the volume threshold is the season input spend at which the volume discount begins.

3. The stacking basis is the basis on which several discounts landing on the same invoice combine. On a best-single basis the largest of the applicable discounts is granted; on a prepay-then-volume basis the prepay and volume rates are added together.

4. The programme rebate is earned on qualifying spend once the enrolled acres reach the rebate acres shown, which are 500 acres on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and 1000 acres on the Precision Partner Input Program Account. No other programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries a rebate.

## Worked comparison (hypothetical)

A member on the Precision Partner Input Program Account pays an invoice on the 20th day after its invoice date: the payment falls on the final day of that programme's 20-day early pay window, so the 2.5 percent early pay rate is the rate that programme carries for it. The same payment on the Standard 30-Day Charge Account, whose window is 10 days, falls outside the window, and the 1 percent rate that programme carries is not reached.
